subtitle: Ibikoresho by'igerageza ku bayobora imurika. Amakuru yose ni ay'igerageza kandi aguma muri iyi mushakisha.
everyRole: Uruhare rwose rw'igerageza rushobora gukoresha ibi bikoresho — ni ibikoresho by'igerageza, si uburenganzira. Buri gikorwa cyandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

reset.title: Subiza igerageza uko ryari
reset.body: Ibi bigarura amakuru y'igerageza y'ibanze, igitabo cy'igenzura n'isaha y'igerageza. Impinduka zakozwe mu igerageza zirasibwa.
reset.confirmTitle: Usubize igerageza uko ryari riri mbere?

language.title: Ururimi
language.body: Hitamo ururimi rw'urubuga. Amahitamo abikwa muri iyi mushakisha kandi agumaho nyuma yo kongera gufungura no gusubiza igerageza uko ryari.

faults.title: Kwigana ibibazo by'itumanaho
faults.body: Igana ibibazo by'itumanaho kugira ngo werekane uko amakosa agaragara. Ibibazo bibikwa hamwe n'amakuru y'igerageza kandi bivanwaho no gusubiza igerageza uko ryari.
faults.latencyHint: Byongerwa kuri buri hamagara rya repository (0–3000 ms).
faults.timeoutHint: Kubika birarangira ariko igisubizo kikabura; kongera kugerageza n'icyifuzo kimwe nta kibazo.
faults.serverErrorHint: Buri hamagara rya repository ryanga n'ikosa rya seriveri mbere yo gukora.
faults.offlineHint: Buri hamagara rya repository ryanga nk'aho nta murandasi uhari.
faults.conflictHint: Kubika gukurikira ku makuru y'igerageza ya WF-01, WF-02 cyangwa WF-03, cyangwa ikosora rikurikira ry'isuzuma ry'igerageza ryakosowe cyangwa ribura igipimo, kugaragaza ukutumvikana kwa verisiyo.

scenario.title: Ibikorwa by'ibyiciro by'igerageza
scenario.body: Tegura ibihe by'imikorere y'igerageza. Ibikorwa by'abandi bantu biraganwa kandi bikamenyekanishwa gutyo.
scenario.wf02Missing: Ikurikirana rya WF-02 ni irya Demo Health Centre Alpha-1. Jya kuri icyo kigo kugira ngo ukoreshe iki gikorwa.
scenario.simulateWf02Hint: Ibika verisiyo nshya y'ikurikirana rya WF-02 nk'umujyanama w'ubuzima wiganwa, ku buryo kubika gukurikira mu rubuga kugaragaza ukutumvikana kwa verisiyo.
